title: STREET MACHINE MAGAZINE
tickerText: ***  SUBSCRIBE TODAY!! ***  STREET MACHINE IS AUSTRALIA’S HOME OF TOUGH STREET CARS, CUSTOM BUILDS, HIGH-PERFORMANCE V8S AND THE PEOPLE WHO BUILD, RACE AND DRIVE THEM. FOR DECADES, STREET MACHINE HAS CELEBRATED AUSTRALIAN CAR CULTURE, FROM WILD HOLDENS, FORDS AND CHRYSLERS TO CHEVROLETS, HOT RODS, SLEEPERS, BURNOUT CARS AND SERIOUSLY QUICK DRAG MACHINES. IT’S ABOUT MORE THAN HORSEPOWER – IT’S THE SHEDS, WORKSHOPS, BUILDERS, RACERS AND ENTHUSIASTS BEHIND THE CARS. STREET MACHINE COVERS MAJOR EVENTS INCLUDING SUMMERNATS, DRAG CHALLENGE, RED CENTRENATS, ROCKYNATS AND MOTOREX, ALONG WITH TECHNICAL FEATURES, PROJECT BUILDS, ENGINE COMBINATIONS AND DIY ADVICE. STREET MACHINE TV ADDS A HUGE VIDEO LIBRARY FEATURING EVERYTHING FROM DYNO SESSIONS AND ENGINE BUILDS TO BURNOUTS AND DRAG RACING. WITH ITS MAGAZINE, WEBSITE, VIDEO CHANNELS, EVENTS AND ENTHUSIAST COMMUNITY, STREET MACHINE REMAINS A DEFINING VOICE OF AUSTRALIAN MODIFIED-CAR CULTURE – BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO BELIEVE CARS SHOULD BE LOUD, FAST, INDIVIDUAL AND DRIVEN
